name: kb_promote
description: Upgrade KB entry confidence: UNVERIFIED -> INFERRED -> CONFIRMED. Appends promotion note to content as evidence trail. CONFIRMED entries are no-op. In a MEMBER session only entries tagged member:<caller uuid> can be promoted; any other id returns not-found and changes nothing. Under an http project KB the id goes to the server unchanged and the member:<caller uuid> own-scope rule is not enforced. Scope: always the calling session's own KB -- a member session uses its registered work folder, any other session the fleet server's working folder; there is no repo/path scope argument (the removed repo_path, repo and repo_remote_url keys fail with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED). Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER, E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO or E-SELF-NO-REMOTE (each with a one-line remediation) when that folder cannot carry a KB identity (it must be a git repository with an origin remote).
